nodes.label: comercio :: estado(p) badges
nodes.rationale: T2 shared commercial-state badges (Agotado / Oferta / Ultimas unidades). Each state carries text + icon (never color only) and is not animated, so it respects photosensitive mode. D1: 'Ultimas unidades' and 'Agotado' come from real stock (CatalogoProducto.stock).

nodes.label: comercio :: precio(p, clase)
nodes.rationale: With a valid offer shows list price struck through (<del>) and offer price (<ins>) with screen-reader text 'Antes/Ahora'. D2: figures always use es-CO separators in all languages.

hyperedges.label: T2 estado comercial y precios de catalogo (stock real, ofertas)
